contributions.anchor: line 1 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED' Column A 'Total this Period' (28,413.88) on the p6 SUMMARY PAGE, which is also the ledger's own printed 'Donations: $ 28,413.88' at the foot of Schedule A sheet 2, and is repeated at summary line 4 and line 5
contributions.detail: 63 contribution rows over two ledger sheets. Sheet 1 (p2, 34 rows) sums to 9,468.85; sheet 2 (p3, 29 rows) sums to 18,945.03; 9,468.85 + 18,945.03 = 28,413.88 exactly = the ledger's own printed 'Donations' total = summary line 1 Column A = line 4 = line 5 (line 3, Balance at Beginning, is a typed 0). A SECOND, INDEPENDENT arithmetic gate exists on the same ledger and also closes: the filer's 'Amt Loaned' column (28 rows) sums to 9,656.88, which is the figure printed beside the Donations total, and the printed 18,757.00 below it equals 28,413.88 - 9,656.88 = the non-loan contributions, which is exactly what the 35 rows with a bare dash in that column sum to. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' is EMPTY on the summary page for both line 1 and line 2, so no cumulative figure is claimed or summed. THE LOAN QUESTION, run through the ladder and not the word (ADDENDUM B3): the 28 candidate rows marked in 'Amt Loaned' are INSIDE the printed 28,413.88 that the summary promotes as Column A, and line 3 (Balance at Beginning) is 0, so there is no beginning-balance slot they could have been booked into — they ARE itemized contribution rows and are published as such.

expenditures.anchor: line 2 'TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE' Column A 'Total this Period' (21,410.78) on the p6 SUMMARY PAGE, which is also the ledger's own printed 'Summary of Expenditures/Loan Repayments: $ 21,410.78' at the foot of Schedule B sheet 2, and is repeated at summary line 6
expenditures.detail: 55 expenditure rows over two ledger sheets. Sheet 1 (p4, 36 rows) sums to 8,983.78; sheet 2 (p5, 19 rows) sums to 12,427.00; 8,983.78 + 12,427.00 = 21,410.78 exactly = the ledger's printed total = summary line 2 Column A = line 6. The whole ladder closes on the page: line 3 (0) + line 4 (28,413.88) = line 5 (28,413.88), minus line 6 (21,410.78) = line 7 'Balance at Close' 7,003.10 as printed. Column B is empty on line 2, so nothing cumulative is summed.

in_kind_convention: monetary-only — the ledger has no in-kind column, no row is annotated in-kind, and no gift-in-kind line appears on the summary page. Both conventions were tested on both sides: monetary-only closes exactly on each side (28,413.88 / 21,410.78) and there is no in-kind figure to add, so monetary-plus-in-kind gives the same sums. The filer's separate 'Amt Loaned' column is a LOAN marker, not an in-kind marker, and is never added to the contribution sum (it is a subset of it).
escalation_note: No figure needed a legibility escalation: every schedule sheet is the filer's own typed spreadsheet reproduced crisply, and the two independent printed totals per side (plus the loan/non-loan split on the contribution side) confirmed all 118 amounts to the cent on the first reading. The eleven geometry crops listed in the frames were rendered at 900 dpi and rotated for reading.

2.measure_note: This sheet is the filer's OWN typed landscape ledger, bound into the county filing ROTATED 90 degrees, so in the raw poppler render the text reads bottom-to-top and the TABLE ROWS ADVANCE ALONG X (axis='x'), ASCENDING left-to-right — the mirror of the weber-rtl-rows shape recorded in ADDENDUM D6, which descends. rowbands.py returns ZERO printed rules on this page (there are none: the ledger is ruled only by whitespace), so the bands were measured by INK PROJECTION in the readable (clockwise-rotated) frame, restricted to the money column, and converted back to the raw frame with x_raw = y_rot and y_raw = 100 - x_rot. The projection found 35 bands: band 1 (raw x 7.71-8.95) is the printed column-header strip ('Date / Donors' Name / Mailing Address / Amount / Amt Loaned') and the remaining 34 are the data rows stored here, matching the 34 entries read off the page. `cells` are the five column bands in raw-y (Date 83.21-92.75, Donors' Name 61.50-79.61, Mailing Address 30.06-58.21, Amount 16.00-25.00, Amt Loaned 6.89-15.24); `cell` is the AMOUNT column, deliberately NOT the 'Amt Loaned' column beside it. TWO-CROP PROOF at 900 dpi --value (crops rendered then rotated for reading): the row-1 box pct:12.07,16.0,1.53,9.0@p2 rendered '$ 210.00' (recorded 210.00) and the row-34 box pct:88.35,16.0,1.47,9.0@p2 rendered '$ 100.00' (recorded 100.00). BOTH CONTROLS: the row-1 crop IS the first-entry control and shows the first written entry in band 1 immediately after the header strip (no skipped line, no banner, no voided row); the ONE-PAST-THE-END control pct:90.6,16.0,1.6,9.0@p2 rendered COMPLETELY BLANK, so nothing continues past the last band.
